nodes.label: OpenAI Key Fix
nodes.rationale: Monitors Cursor's internal vscdb state and automatically toggles the 'OpenAI API Key' setting back on when Cursor silently disables it every few hours.

nodes.label: SQLite Database
nodes.rationale: Maintains persistent app settings, credentials, mappings, and telemetry logs in a local SQLite file (data.db) to guarantee privacy and rapid query execution.

nodes.label: Cursor Custom Model Bypass
nodes.rationale: Cursor update logic bypasses custom OpenAI Base URLs for built-in model names, requiring users to explicitly add custom IDs mapped via Ungate to route proxy traffic.
